sermon.title: "Who Touched Me?"
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: A short message on the woman in Luke 8 who had bled for twelve years, pushed through the crowd and touched the hem of Jesus’ garment. Jesus asked who touched Him so it would be written for us, and the question is whether we are seeking Christ where He is and overcoming the obstacles to reach Him.

Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. But you are not willing to come to Me that you may have life.

faqs.question: What did Jesus say to the religious people?
faqs.answer: That they would not come to Him that they might have life.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But you are not willing to come to Me that you may have life.

faqs.question: What state was she in?
faqs.answer: Desperate; this was her last chance and she didn’t know what else to do.

faqs.question: What did she have to push through?
faqs.answer: A crowd, while sick and hurting, to get to where Jesus was.

faqs.question: Has he preached this before?
faqs.answer: He says he thinks he has preached or mentioned it before.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But Jesus said, “Somebody touched Me, for I perceived power going out from Me.”

faqs.question: What healing do Americans need today?
faqs.answer: Healing for our minds and our spiritual man.

faqs.question: What obstacles does he mention?
faqs.answer: Getting to church on Sunday; some have gotten really good at overcoming them every week.

faqs.question: What do we keep doing despite problems?
faqs.answer: Getting to church, to God’s house.
